name: Implementation Profile: Intersects
abstract: Returns TRUE if this geometric object spatially intersects anotherGeometry (i.e. they share at least one point). Equivalent to the negation of Disjoint.

sources.title: OGC 06-103r4 Simple Feature Access - Part 1: Common Architecture, §6.1.15
